title: SoundTouch local lane API inherited stale bridge secret and failed /execute auth
layer: local 8201 API to 8090 bridge execution auth wiring
symptom: The fresh local lane reported healthy API and bridge endpoints, but SoundTouch run ef19f959 failed with repeated 401 Unauthorized responses on bridge /execute because .env GUI_BRIDGE_SECRET and scripts/bridge/.bridge.env BRIDGE_SECRET were both present and not equal.
smallest_reproducer: Start the local 8201 API with .tmp/start_local_api_8201.py while .env GUI_BRIDGE_SECRET is stale, then call any bridge-backed execute path through api.services.executor._call_execute_bridge against the 8090 bridge.
trust_impact: SoundTouch reruns on the current lane are not semantically interpretable until API and bridge execution auth agree end to end.
allowed_next_actions: restart only the local 8201 API and 8090 bridge pair with aligned secrets
verify /execute auth with one bounded bridge-backed sanity call before rerunning SoundTouch
treat ef19f959 only as an auth-broken run and exclude it from semantic comparison
disallowed_next_actions: full DLL comparison claims based on ef19f959
multi-run retries before execute auth is proven clean
exit_criteria: The restarted 8201 API uses the bridge secret from scripts/bridge/.bridge.env for GUI_BRIDGE_SECRET
A bounded bridge-backed execute call succeeds on the 8201 -> 8090 lane
A subsequent SoundTouch rerun completes without bridge 401 Unauthorized errors
